# Adam S. Kutner, Injury Attorneys

> > Award-winning Las Vegas personal injury law firm with 30+ years of experience representing clients across Nevada in auto accidents, slip-and-fall, workers' compensation, and medical malpractice cases.

Adam S. Kutner's firm specializes in personal injury litigation throughout the Las Vegas Valley and Clark County, Nevada. The firm offers free consultations and serves multiple communities including Henderson, Summerlin, and the Las Vegas Strip.
